svg.aria-label: End-to-end GTM flow: signals are deduped and scored into Attio, hot inbound goes straight to the AE, qualified accounts go to the SDR call queue, AEs run discovery and the deal with LLM-drafted MEDDPICC that they confirm, then paper process and close feed a monthly score recalibration.
svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: White Circle GTM workflow, end to end
svg.text: hot inbound goes straight to the AE
monthly review changes weights, loops back into scoring

g.text: Every automated step writes its runs and API calls to the ops table.
